title: The 10^18 Count
prompt:
**Scenario.** Count integers in [1, N], N ≤ 10^18, whose digit sum is divisible by 9. Which family is forced by the value bound?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Sieve every number up to N

**B)** Digit DP over the ≤ 19 digits, tracking sum mod 9

**C)** Segment tree over the value axis

**D)** DSU on digits

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Walking the value is impossible at 10^18; the state must live on the 19 digit positions plus a mod-9 residue — digit DP.
